artifacts.summary: Locates the in_batch deferral defect in orchestrate-batch-admit.sh's jq collision scan (compares against raw batch membership instead of the set actually admitted this cycle), proposes a reduce-based greedy ascending-order fix that preserves input-order NDJSON output, argues no $schema version bump is needed (same class of change as the documented self-modification tie-breaker precedent), and specifies a regression test scenario (A admitted, C defers on A, D overlaps only C and should now admit) plus placement options.
